message.content:
```python
from seed_emulator import (
    createEmulation,
    makeTransitAs,
    makeStubAsWithHosts,
    createInternetExchange,
    joinInternetExchange,
    Ebgp,
    Network,
    WebServer,
    dump,
)

# Create the emulator
emu = createEmulation("three_as_emulation")

# Create AS150 as a transit AS with 4 routers and 3 networks
as150 = makeTransitAs(emu, asn=150, num_routers=4, num_networks=3)

# Create AS151 as a stub AS with 1 router and 1 web host
as151 = makeStubAsWithHosts(emu, asn=151, num_routers=1, num_hosts=1)
# Create AS152 as a stub AS with 1 router and 1 web host
as152 = makeStubAsWithHosts(emu, asn=152, num_routers=1, num_hosts=1)

# Create an Internet Exchange
ix = createInternetExchange(emu, name="IX1")

# AS151 joins the Internet Exchange
joinInternetExchange(as151, ix)
# AS152 joins the Internet Exchange
joinInternetExchange(as152, ix)

# Set up BGP peering between AS150 and AS151
Ebgp(emu, as150, as151)
# Set up BGP peering between AS150 and AS152
Ebgp(emu, as150, as152)

# Add all layers to the emulator
emu.addLayer(as150)
emu.addLayer(as151)
emu.addLayer(as152)
emu.addLayer(ix)

# Dump the emulator's state to a binary file
dump(emu, "three_as_emulation.bin")
```
